facts.fact: 哈丽特拿起电话听筒贴到耳边，隔着有机玻璃隔断看着汤米。
facts.anchor: Hattie picked up the phone’s handset from its cradle and put it to her ear

facts.fact: 她透过厚厚的有机玻璃隔断看着汤米，等他也拿起听筒。
facts.anchor: She watched Tommy through the thick plexiglass partition, waiting for him to pick up his own handset

facts.fact: 典狱长/警卫说汤米没有脑震荡或骨折，多为表面瘀伤和割伤。
facts.anchor: No concussion or broken bones. Superficial bruising and cuts for the most part.

facts.fact: 在最近一次看病时她的体重降到一百零三磅。
facts.anchor: tipped the scale at a hundred and three.

facts.fact: 警卫说汤米和另外两名囚犯发生了冲突。
facts.anchor: There was an altercation between Tommy and two other inmates.

facts.fact: 控辩双方将在接下来几周做最后陈述。
facts.anchor: The prosecution and defense would be making their final arguments in the coming weeks

facts.fact: 她问汤米是否还好，汤米回答“很好”。
汤米说即使明天被放出去也没用，因为没人相信他。
facts.anchor: It wouldn’t matter if they let me out tomorrow. No one believes me.

facts.fact: 汤米挂断电话起身离开，她坐在原地握着死掉的听筒。
facts.anchor: But he left her sitting where she was, holding the dead handset to her ear
